**Root cause:** `TextChunker.decode` in `httpx/_decoders.py` returned `[content]` unconditionally when `chunk_size is None`. At the end of `iter_text`/`aiter_text`, `decoder.flush()` produces `""`, and `chunker.decode("")` emitted a spurious empty string chunk. `ByteChunker.decode` already guards against this with `[content] if content else []`.

**Fix:** [_decoders.py:213-215](file:///home/andy/cogz_bench/replay_tmp/cogz_replay_1e110964_ate8njry/httpx/_decoders.py) — one-line change mirroring `ByteChunker`. Since `iter_text` and `aiter_text` share `TextChunker`, both sync and async paths are covered; it also stops empty chunks mid-stream from split multi-byte characters.
